name: Direct Haptic Rendering of Isosurface by Intermediate Representation
aliases: Intermediate Representation Approach for Haptic Rendering
definition: A method for direct haptic rendering of isosurfaces in volumetric data using a point-based haptic feedback device, without extracting the isosurface to geometric representations such as polygons. It uses a virtual plane as an intermediate representation of the implicit isosurface to compute point interaction force.
summary: Direct haptic rendering of isosurfaces using an intermediate virtual plane decouples visual rendering from haptic control, eliminating polygonal mesh extraction while maintaining stability and high servo rates.
